Introducing Saved Views, now available today for everyone on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered board or custom sort every morning, this one's for you. Saved Views let you capture exactly how you like to see your work — filters, sorting, grouping, and columns — and return to it in a single click, without repeating the setup each time you open a project.

Every user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for sprint planning, bug triage, client reporting, or whatever your workflow demands. Need your team looking at the same thing? Any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered board instead of describing it in chat or re-creating it by hand.

Saved Views is rolling out now to all paid plans at no extra cost, with no setup required beyond your first view.

We think this small change will save real time across busy projects, and we'd love to hear how you're using it.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
